label: True Color (Optical)
description: Optical true-color band recipes and AOI-aware analysis notes via Host SDK 1.1 (synthetic + AOI + analysis result). No Leaflet; no scene/render/export Host APIs.
notes: Absorbable on current SAT EYE Host SDK 1.1. Reads AOI via host.getAoiBounds, band recipes via host.getSynthetic, publishes via host.setAnalysisResult.
